test_warning_fires_once_before_timeout: test the staged inactivity warning fires once before the full timeout threshold is reached
test_warning_disabled_when_zero: test that no warning fires when the gateway timeout warning threshold is set to zero
test_full_timeout_still_fires_after_warn: test that the full inactivity timeout fires even after a warning was already sent
test_warning_env_var_respected: test that the HERMES_AGENT_TIMEOUT_WARNING environment variable is parsed and respected correctly
test_warning_at_half_timeout: test that the warning fires at half the timeout duration and the full timeout still fires
